does: Executes an interrupt's AdjustRoll functor on the roll it interrupts: evaluates the functor's dice expression (Bardic Inspiration's die) through the expression evaluator, which the registry does not name, and adds the result to the roll's RollAdjustments, which esv::interrupt::ResolveRollAdjustmentsForRoll then turns into the new total.

evidence.says: called from esv::ExecuteStatsFunctor_InterruptContext; builds a thoth ContextData, calls 0x1052660 on the expression and looks the roll up in the RollAdjustments map (0x14378B600)

frame of the return chain of the Generic one-die roll thrown when Interrupt_BardicInspiration_SavingThrow was used on a Sacred Flame save (natural 6, then the save's bonus +0x4 rose by it); from esv::interrupt::UseInterrupt's call 0x3786EE0 through the extender's functor hook
